headline: Cloud Architect | AWS Certified Solutions Architect
summary: Results-oriented Cloud Architect with over 6 years of experience in designing and implementing scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud solutions. Specialized in migrating on-premise infrastructure to AWS, optimizing microservices deployments, and managing high-availability environments for enterprise-level applications in the Nepali tech sector.

experiences.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description: Lead architect for migrating legacy monolithic applications to containerized microservices using AWS EKS.
Reduced cloud infrastructure costs by 30% through comprehensive resource tagging, rightsizing, and implementation of AWS Savings Plans.
Designed and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Terraform, reducing deployment time by 45%.
Mentored a team of 4 junior engineers on best practices for AWS security and compliance.

experiences.title: Cloud Infrastructure Associate
description: Managed multi-region AWS environments, ensuring 99.99% uptime for healthcare data processing platforms.
Implemented automated backup and disaster recovery solutions using AWS Lambda and S3 Lifecycle policies.
Collaborated with development teams to troubleshoot performance bottlenecks in production databases.
Automated server provisioning tasks using Ansible and AWS CloudFormation.
